description: A Non-Capacitor Line Commutated Converter (LCC)-HVDC transmission line. As implemented in PSS/E.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

arc.description: An Arc defining this line `from` a rectifier bus `to` an inverter bus. The rectifier bus must be specified in the `from` bus and inverter bus in the `to` bus.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow on the line. Units: MW.

parameter_units.description: Unit basis for this line's impedance fields (r, rectifier/inverter rc/xc, capacitor reactances, compounding_resistance).

r.description: Series resistance of the DC line. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

transfer_setpoint.description: Desired set-point of power. If `power_mode = true` this value is in MW units, and if `power_mode = false` is in Amperes units. This parameter must not be specified in per-unit. A positive value represents the desired consumed power at the rectifier bus, while a negative value represents the desired power at the inverter bus (i.e. the absolute value of `transfer_setpoint` is the generated power at the inverter bus). Units: per power_mode — true: MW, false: A .

dc_voltage_units.description: Unit basis for the DC voltage fields (scheduled_dc_voltage, switch_mode_voltage, min_compounding_voltage). SYSTEM_BASE: per-unit on the bus base voltage. NATURAL_UNITS: kV.

scheduled_dc_voltage.description: Scheduled compounded DC voltage. By default this parameter is the scheduled DC voltage in the inverter bus. This parameter must not be specified in per-unit. Units: kV. Units: per dc_voltage_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: kV, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

rectifier_bridges.description: Number of bridges in series in the rectifier side.

rectifier_delay_angle_limits.description: Minimum and maximum rectifier firing delay angle (alpha). Units: rad.

rectifier_rc.description: Rectifier commutating transformer resistance per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

rectifier_xc.description: Rectifier commutating transformer reactance per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

rectifier_base_voltage.description: Rectifier primary base AC voltage, entered in kV. Units: kV.

inverter_bridges.description: Number of bridges in series in the inverter side.

inverter_extinction_angle_limits.description: Minimum and maximum inverter extinction angle (gamma). Units: rad.

inverter_rc.description: Inverter commutating transformer resistance per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

inverter_xc.description: Inverter commutating transformer reactance per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

inverter_base_voltage.description: Inverter primary base AC voltage, entered in kV. Units: kV.

power_mode.description: Boolean flag to identify if the LCC line is in power mode or current mode. If `power_mode = true`, setpoint values must be specified in MW, and if `power_mode = false` setpoint values must be specified in Amperes.

switch_mode_voltage.description: Mode switch DC voltage. This parameter must not be added in per-unit. If LCC line is in power mode control, and DC voltage falls below this value, the line switch to current mode control. Units: kV. Units: per dc_voltage_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: kV, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

compounding_resistance.description: Compounding Resistance. This parameter is for control of the DC voltage in the rectifier or inverter end. For inverter DC voltage control, the parameter is set to zero; for rectifier DC voltage control, the parameter is set to the DC line resistance; otherwise, set to a fraction of the DC line resistance. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

min_compounding_voltage.description: Minimum compounded voltage. This parameter must not be added in per-unit. Only used in constant gamma operation (gamma_min = gamma_max), and the AC transformer is used to control the DC voltage. Units: kV. Units: per dc_voltage_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: kV, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

rectifier_transformer_ratio.description: Rectifier transformer ratio between the primary and secondary side AC voltages. Units: 1.

rectifier_tap_limits.description: Minimum and maximum rectifier tap limits as a ratio between the primary and secondary side AC voltages. Units: 1.

rectifier_tap_step.description: Rectifier transformer tap step value. Units: 1.

rectifier_delay_angle.description: Rectifier firing delay angle (alpha). Units: rad.

rectifier_capacitor_reactance.description: Commutating rectifier capacitor reactance magnitude per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

inverter_transformer_ratio.description: Inverter transformer ratio between the primary and secondary side AC voltages. Units: 1.

inverter_tap_limits.description: Minimum and maximum inverter tap limits as a ratio between the primary and secondary side AC voltages. Units: 1.

inverter_tap_step.description: Inverter transformer tap step value. Units: 1.

inverter_capacitor_reactance.description: Commutating inverter capacitor reactance magnitude per bridge. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu. Units: per parameter_units — SYSTEM_BASE: pu, NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, DEVICE_BASE: pu .

active_power_limits_from.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the FROM node. Units: MW.

active_power_limits_to.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the TO node. Units: MW.

reactive_power_limits_from.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits to the FROM node. Units: MVAr.

reactive_power_limits_to.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits to the TO node. Units: MVAr.

loss.description: A generic loss model coefficients. It accepts a linear model with a constant loss and a proportional loss rate (MW of loss per MW of flow). It also accepts a Piecewise loss, with N segments to specify different proportional losses for different segments.
